   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

/*
 * Each section that needs a diagonal bottom edge sets --next-section-bg
 * to match the following section's background. The shared ::after rule
 * reads that variable so the divider triangle blends seamlessly into the
 * next section regardless of viewport width.
 *
 * Section order and backgrounds:
 *   Hero     (#0D0D0D black)  → About     (#F5F5F5 surface-light)
 *   About    (#F5F5F5)        → Skills    (#141414 surface-dark)   [no divider needed — About handles its own bottom]
 *   Skills   (#141414)        → Projects  (#0D0D0D black)
 *   Projects (#0D0D0D black)  → Contact   (#141414 surface-dark)
 */
.section--hero {
  --next-section-bg: var(--color-surface-light);
}

.section--skills {
  --next-section-bg: var(--color-black);
}

.section--projects {
  --next-section-bg: var(--color-surface-dark);
}

.section--hero::after,
.section--skills::after,
.section--projects::after {

  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 80px;
  clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 100% 0, 100% 100%);
